card.name: Partway through chemical and medical terms
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of long chemical or medical words, such as 'astro' in Gastroesophageal, 'ro' in nitro, 'ino' in amino, and 'ite' in metabolite. It also fires on a hyphen inside a chemical name.

modes.label: Gastroesophageal
modes.description: The 'astro' piece after G in Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease.

modes.label: Chemical name parts
modes.description: Pieces or hyphens inside systematic chemical names such as nitro, amino or bromo compounds.

modes.label: Metabolite
modes.description: The ending 'ite' of the word metabolite after 'active'.
